items.source: By default, this is not set, but RequestMappingInfo.Builder defaults to using PathPatternParser unless setPathMatcher(PathMatcher) is explicitly set.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此属性未设置，但 RequestMappingInfo.Builder 默认使用 PathPatternParser，除非显式调用 setPathMatcher(PathMatcher) 进行设置。

items.source: By default, this is not set. You must set it explicitly if you want PathMatcher to be used, or otherwise RequestMappingInfo defaults to using PathPatternParser.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此属性未设置。如果您希望使用PathMatcher，则必须显式设置它；否则，RequestMappingInfo默认将使用PathPatternParser。

items.source: Note: This property is mutually exclusive with setPathMatcher(PathMatcher).
items.translation: 注意： 此属性与 setPathMatcher(PathMatcher) 互斥。

items.source: Enable use of parsed PathPatterns as described in AbstractHandlerMapping.setPatternParser(PathPatternParser).
items.translation: 启用已解析的 PathPatterns，如 AbstractHandlerMapping.setPatternParser(PathPatternParser) 中所描述的那样。

items.source: Return the PathPatternParser to use, the one set explicitly or falling back on a default instance if both PathPatternParser and PathMatcher are not set.
items.translation: 返回要使用的 `PathPatternParser`，即显式设置的实例；如果未设置 `PathPatternParser` 和 `PathMatcher`，则回退到默认实例。

Container for configuration options used for request mapping purposes.

is typically used across all RequestMappingInfo instances.
